text: What are three words your friends would use to describe you?
followUps: Which of those words feels most accurate to you?
What is a word you wish they would use instead?
hint: e.g. 'Loyal, chronically late, and surprisingly stubborn.'

text: What's something you spend a lot of time thinking about?
followUps: When did that fascination or thought loop start?
Does thinking about it bring you energy or drain you?
hint: e.g. 'Whether I should relocate or stay where I am.'

text: What's a part of your personality you're proud of?
followUps: Who or what helped you develop that part of yourself?
When was the last time that quality served you well?
hint: e.g. 'Staying patient when everyone else is frustrated.'

text: What's something you're naturally good at?
followUps: Did you always know you had that ability?
How do you use that gift in your everyday life?
hint: e.g. 'Remembering obscure details people mentioned months ago.'

text: What do you enjoy that most people wouldn't guess?
followUps: Why do you keep that interest low-key?
What feeling does doing it give you?
hint: e.g. 'Solo walks late at night listening to movie soundtracks.'

text: What do people usually misunderstand about you?
followUps: Why do you think people get that first impression?
What is the deeper truth they are missing?
hint: e.g. 'That being quiet means I'm upset or disinterested.'

text: What version of yourself do different people see?
followUps: Which version feels the most exhausting to maintain?
Who gets to see the rawest, unedited version of you?
hint: e.g. 'The organized coworker vs. the completely relaxed friend.'

text: What trait has helped you most in life?
followUps: Was that trait born out of necessity or encouragement?
Can that same trait ever become a blind spot?
hint: e.g. 'Being curious enough to ask when I don't know something.'

text: What trait has made life harder?
followUps: How have you learned to manage or soften it?
What situation triggers that trait the fastest?
hint: e.g. 'Saying yes to too many commitments out of guilt.'

text: What part of yourself took the longest to accept?
followUps: What caused the shift toward self-acceptance?
How does it feel now to look back at your younger self?
hint: e.g. 'That I'm introverted and actually need alone time.'

text: When do you feel most like yourself?
followUps: Where are you and who is around when that happens?
What stops you from being in that state more often?
hint: e.g. 'Cooking dinner while listening to an album I love.'

text: What role do you naturally play in a group?
followUps: Do you choose that role willingly, or is it expected of you?
What happens if you step back and let someone else lead?
hint: e.g. 'The one making sure nobody gets talked over.'

text: What part of your identity matters most to you?
followUps: If you had to let go of everything else, why would you keep that?
How do you protect that core part of you?
hint: e.g. 'Being someone people can rely on in an emergency.'

text: What has shaped who you are more than people realize?
followUps: Was it a specific event, a quiet season, or a person?
Why don't you talk about it very often?
hint: e.g. 'Working a customer service job during college.'

text: What do you hope never changes about you?
followUps: What makes that quality so precious to hold onto?
What forces in the world threaten to erode it?
hint: e.g. 'Getting genuinely excited about other people's wins.'

text: What part of yourself do you hide most often?
followUps: What are you afraid will happen if someone sees it?
Who is the closest to having seen that part of you?
hint: e.g. 'How sensitive I am to people\'s tone of voice.'

text: What insecurity influences you more than you'd like?
followUps: How does that insecurity disguise itself in daily choices?
Where did you first learn to feel inadequate about that?
hint: e.g. 'Worrying that I'm boring when I'm not entertaining people.'

text: What version of yourself are you afraid of becoming?
followUps: Have you ever seen glimpses of that person in stressful moments?
What helps pull you back to who you truly want to be?
hint: e.g. 'Cynical, tired, and too busy to care about small things.'

text: What do you wish people saw in you?
followUps: What would it change about how you walk into rooms?
How does it feel to say that out loud right now?
hint: e.g. 'How much effort I put into making everyone feel comfortable.'

text: What truth about yourself took years to admit?
followUps: What was the cost of denying that truth for so long?
Did accepting it bring peace or grief first?
hint: e.g. 'That I can't fix people who don't want to be helped.'

text: What was your favorite thing to do as a child?
followUps: Who did you usually do that with?
Do you still experience that kind of pure immersion today?
hint: e.g. 'Building blanket forts and reading with a flashlight.'

text: What was your dream job growing up?
followUps: What made that job sound magical to your younger self?
Is there a small element of that dream in what you do now?
hint: e.g. 'An architect or a marine biologist.'

text: What cartoon or show did you love?
followUps: Which character did you relate to most?
What memory of watching it stands out clearest?
hint: e.g. 'Saturday morning cartoons while eating cereal.'

text: What snack reminds you of childhood?
followUps: Where were you usually when you ate it?
Who was the person who bought or prepared it for you?
hint: e.g. 'Warm toast with butter and cinnamon sugar.'

text: What was your favorite place growing up?
followUps: What made that place feel like a sanctuary?
Does that place still exist today?
hint: e.g. 'The backyard treehouse my neighbor built.'

text: What were you like at ten years old?
followUps: Were you quiet, adventurous, anxious, or expressive?
What would that ten-year-old think of your life today?
hint: e.g. 'Quiet, observant, and always carrying a notebook.'

text: What did you think adulthood would be like?
followUps: What has been the biggest pleasant surprise about growing up?
What is the hardest reality you had to adjust to?
hint: e.g. 'Having unlimited freedom and staying up as late as I wanted.'

text: What memory always makes you smile?
followUps: Take me to the exact moment that happened.
Why has that memory stayed so bright over the years?
hint: e.g. 'Road trips with the windows rolled down singing off-key.'

text: What family tradition stands out most?
followUps: Is that a tradition you want to carry forward into your own life?
What feeling was tied to that tradition?
hint: e.g. 'Baking holiday cookies together every December.'

text: What lesson did your childhood teach you?
followUps: Did you learn that lesson gently or through difficulty?
How does that lesson influence your instincts today?
hint: e.g. 'How to entertain myself and enjoy my own company.'

text: Who influenced you most growing up?
followUps: What specific mannerism or belief did you adopt from them?
Do they know how much impact they had on your life?
hint: e.g. 'My middle school art teacher who encouraged my creativity.'

text: What experience changed your childhood?
followUps: How old were you when that happened?
How did your perception of the world split into 'before' and 'after'?
hint: e.g. 'Moving to a different town when I was eight.'

text: What did you need more of as a child?
followUps: Was it safety, praise, freedom, or emotional presence?
How do you try to give that to yourself now?
hint: e.g. 'Reassurance that making a mistake wasn't the end of the world.'

text: What made you feel safe?
followUps: Was it a specific person, a room, or a routine?
What does emotional safety look and feel like to you now?
hint: e.g. 'Hearing my parents' voices in the living room while falling asleep.'

text: What made you feel understood?
followUps: Who was the first person who made you feel truly seen?
What did they do that others didn't?
hint: e.g. 'When a teacher noticed I was struggling without calling me out.'

text: What from your childhood still affects you today?
followUps: When does that early pattern show up in your relationships?
What would it take to finally heal or release that weight?
hint: e.g. 'Feeling like I have to earn rest by being productive first.'

text: What did you learn about love growing up?
followUps: Was love presented as conditional, quiet, intense, or scarce?
What have you had to consciously redefine about love?
hint: e.g. 'That it was shown through acts of service rather than words.'

text: What's something your younger self deserved?
followUps: Why didn't they receive that at the time?
Can you give a piece of that validation to yourself right now?
hint: e.g. 'More patience when I was struggling in school.'

text: What's something you've had to unlearn?
followUps: What was the moment you realized that belief was hurting you?
How do you catch yourself when the old pattern kicks in?
hint: e.g. 'That disagreeing with someone doesn't mean a fight.'

text: If you could speak to your younger self, what would you say?
followUps: Would they be surprised by where you are sitting right now?
What reassurance do you still need to hear from yourself?
hint: e.g. 'Stop worrying so much — it turns out okay in the end.'

text: What makes someone easy to talk to?
followUps: What body language or energy puts you at ease?
Who in your life embodies that conversational safety?
hint: e.g. 'When they don't jump in to give advice right away.'

text: What's your favorite thing to do with friends?
followUps: Do you prefer high-energy outings or quiet conversations?
What makes shared downtime feel so restorative?
hint: e.g. 'Grabbing takeout and talking for hours on the living room floor.'

text: What type of friend are you?
followUps: Are you the listener, the planner, the truth-teller, or the comic?
Which role feels most natural to you?
hint: e.g. 'The loyal planner who always brings the snacks.'

text: What quality attracts you to people?
followUps: Is it curiosity, warmth, intelligence, or humor?
How quickly can you sense that in someone?
hint: e.g. 'A dry sense of humor and unpretentious kindness.'

text: What's the funniest thing a friend has done?
followUps: Take me back to the exact moment that happened.
How hard did you laugh in that room?
hint: e.g. 'Accidentally sending a voice memo singing to a group chat.'

text: What makes you trust someone?
followUps: Is trust built over time or felt almost immediately in your gut?
What is one green flag that instantly signals integrity to you?
hint: e.g. 'When they defend people who aren't in the room.'

text: What makes you feel included?
followUps: What small gesture makes you feel like you truly belong?
When have you felt like an outsider looking in?
hint: e.g. 'Someone actively bringing me into a group conversation.'

text: How do you usually make friends?
followUps: Do you initiate easily, or do you wait for others to approach?
Has making friends become harder or easier as you've gotten older?
hint: e.g. 'Through shared projects or regular routine meetups.'

text: What quality keeps friendships strong?
followUps: How do you maintain depth when life gets busy?
What is the foundation that keeps long-distance friendships alive?
hint: e.g. 'Being able to pick right back up after months apart.'

text: What kind of people bring out your best side?
followUps: What happens to your energy when you are around them?
What side of you emerges in their presence?
hint: e.g. 'Curious people who ask interesting questions.'

text: What friendship taught you the most?
followUps: What did that relationship reveal about your own boundaries or loyalty?
Are you still in touch with that person today?
hint: e.g. 'One where we grew apart and learned to let go gently.'

text: What makes someone unforgettable?
followUps: Who is a person you only knew briefly who left a lasting mark on you?
What was it about their presence that stayed with you?
hint: e.g. 'The way they made me feel completely seen and valued.'

text: What do you appreciate most in your closest friends?
followUps: Have you told them that recently?
What makes that specific quality irreplaceable?
hint: e.g. 'Never having to pretend to be upbeat when I'm exhausted.'

text: When do you feel closest to people?
followUps: Is it during shared struggle, silent presence, or deep late-night talks?
How does that closeness feel in your body?
hint: e.g. 'During late-night conversations when everyone drops their guard.'

text: What does loyalty mean to you?
followUps: How has your standard for loyalty changed over time?
What is an act of loyalty you will never forget?
hint: e.g. 'Showing up consistently, especially when it's inconvenient.'

text: What's the hardest friendship lesson you've learned?
followUps: Did that lesson make you more guarded or more intentional?
What did you have to forgive yourself for in that situation?
hint: e.g. 'That distance and effort have to be mutual to survive.'

text: Have you ever outgrown a friendship?
followUps: Was there a definitive ending, or a slow, quiet drifting apart?
How did you process the grief of losing that shared world?
hint: e.g. 'Yes, when our values and lifestyle stopped aligning.'

text: What friendship loss affected you most?
followUps: What part of yourself did you feel you lost along with them?
If you could have one final conversation with them, what would you say?
hint: e.g. 'A childhood friend drifting away with no big argument.'

text: What's difficult for you in friendships?
followUps: Is it expressing hurt, asking for help, or staying consistent?
How does that difficulty manifest between us?
hint: e.g. 'Being vulnerable about my own struggles instead of just listening.'

text: What do you wish your friends understood better?
followUps: Why is that difficult to explain to people in the moment?
How can the people close to you support you when you're there?
hint: e.g. 'That going quiet usually means I'm overwhelmed, not distant.'

text: What's a place you want to visit?
followUps: What is the first thing you would do when you landed there?
What image or feeling draws you to that specific destination?
hint: e.g. 'A quiet seaside village in northern Spain.'

text: What's a skill you'd love to learn?
followUps: What would you build or do once you mastered it?
What has kept you from diving into it so far?
hint: e.g. 'Woodworking or playing the acoustic guitar.'

text: What's on your bucket list?
followUps: Which item on that list feels closest within your reach?
Who would you want beside you when you accomplish it?
hint: e.g. 'Seeing the Northern Lights in winter.'

text: What's something you're excited about?
followUps: How does your daily energy shift when you anticipate it?
What is the best part of looking forward to that?
hint: e.g. 'An upcoming trip with close friends next month.'

text: What's a hobby you'd like to try?
followUps: What draws you toward that particular craft or activity?
What is holding you back from starting this weekend?
hint: e.g. 'Ceramics and wheel throwing.'

text: What does success mean to you?
followUps: How is your definition different from what society expects of you?
When was the last time you felt truly successful inside?
hint: e.g. 'Going to sleep without worrying about tomorrow's schedule.'

text: What motivates you right now?
followUps: Is that motivation driven by inspiration, curiosity, or necessity?
What helps you keep moving forward on days when motivation dips?
hint: e.g. 'Saving up enough to have total peace of mind.'

text: What's a goal you're working toward?
followUps: What will daily life look like once you achieve that goal?
What is the hardest part of the process right now?
hint: e.g. 'Running a 10k race by the end of the year.'

text: What kind of lifestyle appeals to you?
followUps: Describe the rhythm of your ideal morning and evening.
What trade-offs are you willing to make to build that life?
hint: e.g. 'Mornings with no rush and evenings cooking at home.'

text: What are you curious about lately?
followUps: What rabbit hole have you fallen down recently?
What does that curiosity say about what you're seeking right now?
hint: e.g. 'How different architectural styles shape mood and community.'

text: What dream have you held onto the longest?
followUps: How has that dream matured or changed form over the years?
Why has that desire refused to die out?
hint: e.g. 'Designing and building a custom cabin in the woods.'

text: What would you do if money didn't matter?
followUps: How would you spend your working hours?
What kind of community or environment would you create around yourself?
hint: e.g. 'Run a small neighborhood bookshop and café.'

text: What's something you want to build?
followUps: Is it a tangible creation, a family culture, a business, or a sanctuary?
Who is that creation meant to serve?
hint: e.g. 'A community space where people can gather and work together.'

text: What impact would you like to have?
followUps: In whose life do you most want to make a lasting difference?
How do you want people to feel when they remember your name?
hint: e.g. 'Leaving people feeling lighter and more encouraged after talking.'

text: What are you chasing right now?
followUps: Is chasing it giving you joy or making you restless?
What do you hope you will feel once you catch it?
hint: e.g. 'A healthier balance between ambitious work and actual rest.'

text: What dream are you afraid to say out loud?
followUps: Why does stating that dream feel dangerous or vulnerable?
How does it feel to finally share it with me tonight?
hint: e.g. 'Starting my own studio and leaving corporate work behind.'

text: What dream have you almost given up on?
followUps: What made it feel too heavy or improbable to carry?
Is there still a small ember of hope left in your heart for it?
hint: e.g. 'Writing and publishing a complete novel.'

text: What would a meaningful life look like?
followUps: What would you have to let go of to live that way fully?
What is one courageous step you could take toward it this month?
hint: e.g. 'Doing work I respect and having daily dinners with people I love.'

text: What's worth struggling for?
followUps: What makes that struggle sacred rather than merely painful?
How has enduring that struggle shaped your character?
hint: e.g. 'Building deep relationships that withstand hard seasons.'

text: What future are you trying to create?
followUps: Who do you want beside you in that future?
What promise can you make to yourself right now about that vision?
hint: e.g. 'A life with more financial peace and creative freedom.'

text: What's something that makes you nervous?
followUps: How does that nervousness show up physically in your body?
What is your go-to ritual for calming yourself down?
hint: e.g. 'Speaking up in a room full of senior people.'

text: What's your biggest irrational fear?
followUps: When did that fear first start?
What is the most ridiculous situation it has caused for you?
hint: e.g. 'Moths and checking behind the shower curtain.'

text: What challenge intimidates you?
followUps: What makes that challenge feel so daunting right now?
What is the smallest step you could take to face it?
hint: e.g. 'Leading a major project completely on my own.'

text: What's something outside your comfort zone?
followUps: When was the last time you pushed past your usual boundaries?
How did you feel on the other side of that experience?
hint: e.g. 'Attending a networking event where I know nobody.'

text: What risk would you like to take?
followUps: What is the upside you keep envisioning?
What has stopped you from taking that leap so far?
hint: e.g. 'Switching careers into a field I have no formal degree in.'

text: What kind of failure worries you?
followUps: Is it failing publicly, failing someone you love, or failing yourself?
What meaning do you attach to that potential failure?
hint: e.g. 'Putting 100% effort into something and still falling short.'

text: What fear has followed you longest?
followUps: Where did that fear take root in your earlier years?
How has your relationship with that fear changed as you've grown?
hint: e.g. 'Not living up to the potential people saw in me as a kid.'

text: What makes you doubt yourself?
followUps: What triggers your inner imposter or critic most reliably?
What helps restore your self-trust when doubt creeps in?
hint: e.g. 'Comparing my timeline to people my age on social media.'

text: What fear has become smaller over time?
followUps: What experience gave you the evidence to shrink that fear?
How does knowing you overcame it give you strength today?
hint: e.g. 'Eating alone at a restaurant or going to movies solo.'

text: What fear still feels large?
followUps: How much energy do you spend avoiding or managing that fear?
What would your life look like if that fear lost 50% of its power?
hint: e.g. 'Making a life-altering choice that I can't undo.'

text: What fear influences your decisions?
followUps: Has that fear kept you safe, or has it kept you small?
What decision would you make tomorrow if that fear vanished?
hint: e.g. 'Financial instability making me hesitate to take big leaps.'

text: What fear do people not know you have?
followUps: Why do you keep that fear hidden from most people?
What would happen if you were open about it?
hint: e.g. 'That I appear confident on the outside while second-guessing.'

text: What are you afraid of losing?
followUps: Is it a person, a feeling of security, your health, or your freedom?
How does that fear shape the way you hold onto what you love?
hint: e.g. 'The close circle of friends I have right now as life moves on.'

text: What keeps you from taking bigger risks?
followUps: What is the worst-case scenario that plays in your mind?
What is the cost of staying where it is comfortable and predictable?
hint: e.g. 'The comfort of my current predictable routine.'

text: What fear has taught you something useful?
followUps: What wisdom did you gain by walking through that anxiety?
How has that insight made you more compassionate toward others?
hint: e.g. 'Fear of public speaking taught me thorough preparation.'

text: What are you most afraid of becoming?
followUps: Have you seen glimpses of that in yourself during hard seasons?
What helps you pull back and recommit to your values?
hint: e.g. 'Bitter or closed-off because of past disappointments.'

text: What fear would change your life if you overcame it?
followUps: What doors would immediately open for you?
What is one brave conversation that could begin that shift?
hint: e.g. 'The fear of putting my creative work out there publicly.'

text: What fear rarely leaves you?
followUps: How do you carry that companion without letting it run your life?
What brings you comfort when that fear is loud?
hint: e.g. 'That I might look back and realize I played it too safe.'

text: What fear do you wish you could let go of?
followUps: How much lighter would your chest feel without that weight?
What would it take to let it drop to the floor tonight?
hint: e.g. 'Worrying constantly about what others think of my choices.'

text: What fear feels closest to your heart?
followUps: What makes that fear so tender to speak about?
How does it feel to share it with me right now?
hint: e.g. 'Disappointing the people who believe in me.'

text: When do you feel closest to me?
followUps: Why that moment?
What made it meaningful to you?
hint: e.g. 'When we're laughing quietly together after a long day.'

text: What do I do that makes you feel deeply loved?
followUps: When did you first notice that?
What is something small I do that matters most?
hint: e.g. 'Remembering the small things I mentioned in passing.'

text: What's something you've never told me before?
followUps: What made that difficult to share?
What support do you need from me?
hint: e.g. 'How nervous I was the first time we hung out one-on-one.'

text: What fear do you have about our relationship or future?
followUps: Where does that fear stem from?
How can we navigate that together?
hint: e.g. 'That life gets too busy and we stop making time for just us.'

text: When do you feel most misunderstood by me?
followUps: What happens in those moments?
How can I listen better when that happens?
hint: e.g. 'When I get quiet to process thoughts and it seems like coldness.'

text: What's something you're still healing from that affects us?
followUps: When did that start?
How can I hold space for you?
hint: e.g. 'An old habit of shutting down when I get stressed.'

text: What kind of life do you dream of us building in ten years?
followUps: Why is that vision meaningful to you?
What excites you most about it?
hint: e.g. 'A home with a garden and time for spontaneous weekend trips.'

text: What's an adventure or dream you're afraid to hope for?
followUps: Why that dream?
What feels like it's standing in the way?
hint: e.g. 'Taking a multi-month sabbatical to live by the coast.'

text: What's something we've overcome together that made us stronger?
followUps: What did that season teach you about us?
How did our bond change afterward?
hint: e.g. 'Navigating a hectic move under tight deadlines without arguing.'

text: What part of yourself are you still learning to embrace?
followUps: Why has that been a journey for you?
When do you feel most at ease with it?
hint: e.g. 'My need for quiet downtime without feeling guilty.'

text: What's a fear you've never fully overcome?
followUps: When did that fear first take root?
What helps you feel brave when it appears?
hint: e.g. 'Feeling like an imposter even after achieving a milestone.'

text: What's something you're currently healing from?
followUps: What has been the hardest part of that process?
What has given you comfort or strength?
hint: e.g. 'The burnout from prioritizing work over my health last year.'

text: What's a mistake that completely changed the trajectory of your life?
followUps: How did you handle the aftermath?
What wisdom did you gain from it?
hint: e.g. 'Choosing the safe career path first before switching to what I loved.'

text: What's something about your inner world you're afraid people won't understand?
followUps: Why does it feel risky to share?
What would true understanding feel like?
hint: e.g. 'How often I overthink interactions long after they're over.'

text: What's a dream for your life that you rarely say out loud?
followUps: What makes that dream so sacred to you?
What would your life feel like if it came true?
hint: e.g. 'Building something entirely my own from scratch.'

text: What challenge in the last five years made you who you are today?
followUps: What kept you going during that time?
What are you proud of regarding how you handled it?
hint: e.g. 'Starting over after a job layoff and figuring out what mattered.'

text: What values do you refuse to compromise on, no matter what?
followUps: Where did that conviction come from?
How has it shaped your friendships?
hint: e.g. 'Honesty in difficult moments and treating everyone with respect.'

text: What's something you wish more people knew about you?
followUps: Why is that part often hidden?
How can the people close to you see it more?
hint: e.g. 'That I'm a lot warmer once the initial shyness passes.'

text: What future excites you most when you think about where you're heading?
followUps: What are you doing now to get there?
Who do you want by your side?
hint: e.g. 'Having more autonomy over my daily schedule and projects.'

text: What memory of our friendship always brings you joy?
followUps: What made that day or moment stand out?
What do you appreciate most about our bond?
hint: e.g. 'The time we got stranded in the rain and couldn't stop laughing.'

text: What's something you're better at than most people realize?
followUps: Who first noticed that in you?
Do you enjoy it as much as you're good at it?
hint: e.g. 'I'm surprisingly good at staying calm in a crisis.'

text: What kind of people make you feel most like yourself?
followUps: What do they do, exactly?
Do you have someone like that in your life right now?
hint: e.g. 'People who don't need me to perform for them.'

text: What's a belief about yourself you're still testing?
followUps: What made you start questioning it?
What would it mean if it turned out to be true?
hint: e.g. 'That I'm actually good at leading, not just following.'

text: What's a part of yourself you've had to fight to keep?
followUps: Who or what was working against it?
What does keeping it cost you?
hint: e.g. 'My softness, in places that reward being hard.'

text: What do you like about who you're becoming?
followUps: What changed recently that made you notice?
Who's helped you get there?
hint: e.g. 'I'm slower to anger than I used to be.'

text: What's a compliment you've never fully believed?
followUps: Why does it feel untrue?
What would it take to believe it?
hint: e.g. 'That I'm easy to talk to.'

text: What do you do that nobody taught you?
followUps: Where do you think it came from?
Has anyone else noticed it?
hint: e.g. 'I hum without noticing when I'm concentrating.'

text: What's a label you've outgrown?
followUps: Who still sees you that way?
What replaced it?
hint: e.g. 'The quiet one.'

text: What's a memory you didn't know you'd keep until years later?
followUps: What makes it stick?
Who else was there?
hint: e.g. 'My dad humming while fixing something.'

text: What's a story your family tells about you that you don't fully agree with?
followUps: What's your version of it?
Why do you think theirs stuck?
hint: e.g. 'That I was always brave — I remember being terrified.'

text: What's a moment that quietly changed how you see the world?
followUps: Did you notice the change right away?
What did you see differently after?
hint: e.g. 'The first time I traveled somewhere alone.'

text: What's something you had to go through alone that you wish you hadn't?

text: What's the best piece of advice you ignored at the time?

text: What's a place that shaped you more than you'd expect?

text: What's something you had to forgive yourself for?

text: What's a rule you grew up with that you've since broken?

text: What do you admire in people even when it costs them?

text: What's a value you hold that most people around you don't share?

text: What would you stand up for even if you were the only one?

text: What kind of honesty is hardest for you to give?

text: What's something small that tells you a lot about someone's character?

text: What would you regret not trying?

text: What matters to you now that didn't a few years ago?

text: What kind of impact do you want to leave, even in small ways?

text: What are you hoping doesn't run out of time?

text: Tell a story you'll still remember when you're 80.

text: Describe your ideal ordinary day, ten years from now.

What's one step toward it today?

text: What do you hope people remember about you?

Are you living toward it now?

text: Share something you've thought but never said out loud, to anyone.

How does it feel to say it now?

text: What's a small luxury in your daily life you're grateful for?
followUps: How long has that been part of your routine?
What would your day feel like without it?

text: Who is someone you're glad you met this past year?

text: What's something about where you live that you appreciate?

text: What's an act of kindness someone did for you that you never forgot?

text: What's a hardship you went through that you're now grateful happened?

text: What's something about your current health or body you appreciate?

How do you care for that part of you?

text: What quality in your partner or closest friend are you most thankful for?

How has that quality shaped you?

text: What's a chapter of your life you wouldn't trade for anything?

text: What's a compliment someone gave you that still warms your heart?
followUps: Who said that to you?
Did that match how you saw yourself?

text: What's something about our connection that you don't take for granted?

text: Who in your life helped you become who you are, and what would you thank them for?

What holds you back if not?

text: What's a minor pet peeve that instantly annoys you?

text: When you're overwhelmed, what's the first thing you tend to snap at?

text: How do you usually handle disagreement — confront immediately or withdraw first?

text: What's something that makes an apology feel sincere to you?

text: What's a topic where you find it hardest to compromise?

text: What's a recurring misunderstanding you've had in relationships?

What would break the cycle?

text: When someone hurts your feelings, do you tend to show anger or go quiet?

text: What's something you find difficult to ask for directly?

text: What's a conflict from your past you wish you had handled differently?

text: When we have tension, what's one thing I could do that would lower your defenses?

text: What is a place in the world where your soul feels most rested and alive?

text: What is an experience or milestone you want us to share before this year ends?

text: What was a moment between us where you felt completely understood without needing many words?
